title: Watch: What leaked audio reveals about Spain train crash
description: Recordings between a control centre and the train drivers appear to show one train was given clearance to move even though another train had stalled on the track.
text: Leaked audio recordings published by Spanish media have shed light on communications between a control centre and train drivers in the moments before two trains collided outside Toledo.
Officials are investigating the cause of the disaster, which occurred when a train from Madrid to Seville barrelled into a stationary train.
Southern Europe correspondent Sarah Rainsford explains what the audio reveals.
